commands.welcome:
Welcome! It looks like this is your first run.
Here's how to get started:
  1. priority add <game>  — add games to your priority list
  2. mode priority_only    — mine only priority-list games
  3. resume               — start mining drops
  Type 'help' to see all available commands.

commands.about_how_text: Every several seconds, the application pretends to watch a particular stream by fetching stream metadata — this is enough to advance the drops. Note that this completely bypasses the need to download any actual stream of video and sound. To keep the status (ONLINE or OFFLINE) of the channels up-to-date, a websocket connection receives events about streams going up or down, or updates regarding the current number of viewers.
commands.about_started_text:
1. Login to the application.
2. Ensure your Twitch account is linked to all campaigns you're interested in mining.
3. Use 'priority add <game>' to add games to your priority list.
4. Use 'mode priority_only' to mine only priority-list games.
5. Use 'exclude add <game>' to never mine a specific game.
6. Run 'reload' after changing priority/exclude lists for changes to take effect.
7. If no campaigns show up, run 'login browser' and sign in once in the browser window it opens - see the Getting started guide.
commands.about_disclaimer:
1. This tool requires a Twitch login. Your account credentials are stored locally and are never collected or transmitted.
2. Use at your own risk. We are not responsible for any account issues, including but not limited to bans or suspensions, resulting from the use of this tool.
3. Please verify claimed drops on the Twitch Drops Inventory page.
4. Some games may not reliably track watch time due to issues on Twitch's side.
5. Closing the tool will stop all mining. Keep it running to continue earning drops.
6. If no campaigns appear at all, that is a login limitation - run 'login browser'. Running 'reload' will not help.

help.how_it_works_text: Every several seconds, the application pretends to watch a particular stream by fetching stream metadata - this is enough to advance the drops. Note that this completely bypasses the need to download any actual stream of video and sound. To keep the status (ONLINE or OFFLINE) of the channels up-to-date, there's a websocket connection established that receives events about streams going up or down, or updates regarding the current number of viewers.
help.getting_started_text:
1. Login to the application.
2. Ensure your Twitch account is linked to all campaigns you're interested in mining.
3. If you're interested in mining everything possible, change the Priority Mode to anything other than "Priority list only" and press on "Reload".
4. If you want to mine specific games first, use the "Priority" list to set up an ordered list of games of your choice. Games from the top of the list will be attempted to be mined first, before the ones lower down the list.
5. Keep the "Priority mode" selected as "Priority list only", to avoid mining games that are not on the priority list. Or not - it's up to you.
6. Use the "Exclude" list to tell the application which games should never be mined.
7. Changing the contents of either of the lists, or changing the "Priority mode", requires you to press on "Reload" for the changes to take an effect.
